items.before: Before, INS and plants pages were titled like 'Address book | Import notification service'. Now they read 'Address book - Import notification service - GOV.UK', as live animals pages already did, with 'Error: ' in front when the page shows errors. The INS home is titled 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK'.
items.after:
Before, INS and plants page titles read like 'Address book | Import notification service'.

Now they read 'Address book - Import notification service - GOV.UK'.

Live animals pages already used this pattern.

When a page shows errors, its title now starts with 'Error: '.

The INS home page is titled 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK'.

items.before: Page titles on the INS front door and in plants follow the GOV.UK title pattern, including the INS home's 'Dashboard' title
items.after: Page titles on the INS front door and in plants follow the GOV.UK title pattern. This includes the 'Dashboard' title on the INS home page.
